source: AI4I 2020 Predictive Maintenance Dataset (UCI, CC BY 4.0): 10,000 machining runs, 339 failures.

modes.name: Heat dissipation failure
modes.rule: Process minus air temperature below 8.6 K AND spindle speed below 1380 rpm

modes.name: Power failure
modes.rule: Power (torque × speed) below 3,500 W or above 9,000 W

modes.name: Overstrain failure
modes.rule: Tool wear × torque above 11,000 (L), 12,000 (M) or 13,000 (H) min·Nm

modes.name: Random failure
modes.rule: About 0.1% chance on any run — no warning sign
